Package info.kgeorgiy.ja.baronov.implementor

Class Implementor

java.lang.Object
info.kgeorgiy.ja.baronov.implementor.Implementor
All Implemented Interfaces:
Impler, JarImpler
public class Implementor extends Object implements JarImpler

The Implementor class is responsible for generating implementations for Java interfaces or creating JAR files containing those implementations.

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      The main method to launch the program. It accepts command-line arguments to generate the class code for an interface or a JAR file containing the class implementation.
      Parameters:
      args - Command-line arguments: - optionally, -jar output JAR file for creating a JAR file. - class name - name of the interface. - output directory - directory to save the generated code.

    • implement

      public void implement(Class<?> token, Path root) throws ImplerException
      Generates java class that implements the given interface. Saves file in root directory
      Specified by:
      implement in interface Impler
      Parameters:
      token - The interface for which the class needs to be generated.
      root - The directory where the generated Java file will be saved.
      Throws:
      ImplerException - If an error occurs during code generation:
      • Invalid arguments (e.g., token or root are null)
      • Error creating directories for the file
      • Error creating the file itself
      • Error writing content to the file

    • implementJar

      public void implementJar(Class<?> token, Path jarFile) throws ImplerException
      Generates Jar file that implements the given interface.
      Specified by:
      implementJar in interface JarImpler
      Parameters:
      token - The interface for which the JAR needs to be created.
      jarFile - The path to the JAR file.
      Throws:
      ImplerException - If an error occurs during JAR file generation:
      • Invalid arguments (e.g., token or jarFile are null)
      • Error generating source code
      • Compilation error of the generated code
      • Error creating the JAR file (unable to open or write to the file)
      • Error writing classes to the JAR
      • Error deleting tempDirectories that was created to save java file and compiled file
